bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
db=deploy-postgres-1
docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format 'GAYBBS_RUNNING={{.State.Running}} RESTARTS={{.RestartCount}}'
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT 'EVENT',e.kind,e.state,r.status,count(*) FROM room_source_events e JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=e.room_id GROUP BY e.kind,e.state,r.status ORDER BY e.kind,e.state,r.status" || exit 71
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT 'EDIT',e.kind,q.state,r.status,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text IS NULL THEN 'NO_TEXT' ELSE 'TEXT_SAVED' END,CASE WHEN d.inline_buttons IS NULL THEN 'NO_MARKUP' ELSE 'MARKUP_SAVED' END,count(*) FROM room_status_message_edits q JOIN room_source_events e ON e.event_id=q.room_event_id JOIN posting_deliveries d ON d.delivery_id=q.delivery_id JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id GROUP BY e.kind,q.state,r.status,5,6 ORDER BY e.kind,q.state,r.status" || exit 72
docker exec "$db" psql -X -U gace -d gaybbs -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -At -F '|' -c "SELECT 'CARD',status,marker,count(*) FROM (SELECT r.status AS status,CASE WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%✅ 終了%' THEN 'FINISHED_MARK' WHEN d.rendered_text LIKE '%🔴 LIVE中%' THEN 'LIVE_MARK' ELSE 'OTHER' END AS marker FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON a.announcement_id::text=d.source_id JOIN room_posts r ON r.room_id=a.room_id WHERE d.source_type='announcement' AND d.status='sent' AND d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL) s GROUP BY status,marker ORDER BY status,marker" || exit 73
echo WORKER_FAILURES_LAST_8M=$(docker logs --since 8m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -c 'GAYBBS_WORKER_CHECK_FAILED' || :)
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 74
echo ROOM_SYNC_DIAG_DONE
